name: Infinity Climb
summary:
**THE TOWER HAS NO END.**

At least, no one has ever climbed high enough to prove otherwise.

**Infinity Climb** is an intense VR climbing challenge where every movement comes from your own arms. Push, launch, grab, swing, and pull yourself upward through a massive alien structure built to test your skill.

Navigate shifting platforms, rotating cylinders, dangerous traps, difficult jumps, and climbable surfaces suspended impossibly high above the world.

Every section demands better timing, stronger movemen
